summary: Round 1 major fixed: AmountRule now takes the configured limit currency, raises InvalidAssessmentException for a payment in another currency (AmountRuleTest#otherCurrencyIsInvalid), and the service passes command.currency(). AC5.1 and B1 remain met. Working tree clean, test-summary pass on HEAD (464/464). HEAD is not pushed yet, so GitHub has no check runs for it (treated as absent).

AssessRiskService writes inbox and outbox reply in one @Transactional; redelivery test asserts exactly one reply
